description: Small businesses are part of what makes Kāneʻohe feel like home, but many are struggling to survive under the weight of high startup costs, permitting delays, and limited support. When local businesses close, our whole community feels it. Kāneʻohe deserves leadership that understands these challenges and takes action.
title: Kāneʻohe Ranked Among the Worst For Small Businesses: What’s Holding Us Back?
